title: KaralisB - Rimi un Maxima
description: A mod that adds Rimi and Maxima's structures to the game. I just made this mod for fun, don't take anything in this mod seriously or to heart.
body:
The mod adds a Rimi structure and Maxima structure (2 popular stores from Latvia).
These structures contain new villagers with who you can trade with for food items, with relaistic prices from the actual stores (euro/kg - emerald/item). They also have storage rooms with pretty good items inside.
It is recommended to use this mod together with the origins mod, as well as rimi and maxima datapack for better game quality.
For more info about the mod check out this tiktok: [https://www.tiktok.com/@karalisb_/video/7468978887112903969?lang=en]
